neighbours.label: word marking physical height above a reference level ('ten feet above the roof', 'metres above sea level', 'off the ground')
fire: The camera is fixed on a pole about six metres above the street.
The village lies nearly a thousand metres above sea level in the Alps.
Hang the birdhouse at least five feet above the ground, away from cats.
The kite drifted forty metres above the beach before the string snapped.
Keep the shelf about two metres above the floor so children cannot reach it.
The lighthouse lamp sits sixty feet above the high-water mark.
The helicopter hovered just above the rooftops while the crew filmed.
Fit the smoke alarm a few inches below the ceiling, well above the stove.
quiet: The camera is fixed on a pole at the corner of the street.
The village lies in a quiet valley in the Alps, close to the border.
Hang the birdhouse in a quiet corner of the garden, away from cats.
Her test scores were above the national average this year.
Keep the shelf in a dry room so the books do not get damp.
Temperatures this week were well above normal for October.
The helicopter flew from the hospital to the airport in ten minutes.
Fit the smoke alarm in the hallway, where everyone can hear it.

notes: Probe: 'ten feet above the roof' 0.81, 'above sea level' 0.54, 'off the ground' 0.36, 'rises ... above' 0.23; 'above average' 0.03, 'shipped from' 0.05.
